title: When Can Digital Personas Reliably Approximate Human Survey Findings?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing digital persona prediction accuracy and exact-match performance across gender groups using the mean absolute deviation of the Demographic Parity Index (DPI).

Comparing digital persona prediction accuracy and exact-match performance across different age groups (e.g., 18-34, 35-49, 50-64, 65+) using the mean absolute deviation of the Demographic Parity Index (DPI).
